scripts.validate:hotel: npm run build:web && npm run validate:hotel:portable && npm run validate:hotel:sites
scripts.validate:vercel: npm run build:web && node scripts/validate_vercel_site.mjs && node scripts/validate_service_integrations.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint:oxlint && npm run lint:biome
scripts.lint:oxlint: oxlint --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives examples/hotel-booking-demo src/typescript/hotel src/typescript/test/hotel-booking-*.test.js src/typescript/test/webmcp-hotel-adapter.test.js scripts/*hotel*.mjs scripts/build_web_site.mjs scripts/validate_service_integrations.mjs scripts/validate_source_quality_tools.mjs scripts/validate_void_integration.mjs
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json biome.json package.json void.json scripts/validate_source_quality_tools.mjs scripts/validate_void_integration.mjs src/typescript/test/hotel-booking-visualization.test.js
scripts.format:write: oxfmt --write .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json biome.json package.json void.json scripts/validate_source_quality_tools.mjs scripts/validate_void_integration.mjs src/typescript/test/hotel-booking-visualization.test.js
scripts.quality:check: npm run quality:versions && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.build:void:static: npm run build:web && npm run validate:void
scripts.deploy:void:static: npm run build:void:static && void deploy --dir dist/client
